executiveSummary: National-security risks escalated as U.S. officials reported AI-enabled impersonation campaigns targeting senior leaders and their contacts, indicating credible espionage and influence-operation tradecraft using synthetic voice and messaging. Source In a related development, the Justice Department and FBI disrupted a suspected China-backed network that used fabricated personas and AI-generated photos to solicit sensitive U.S. government information via 13 front websites. Source Law-enforcement action against nonconsensual deepfake sexual abuse continued: U.S. and French authorities seized domain names and assets tied to large-scale sites distributing nude digital forgeries, while separate federal charges under a new U.S. law underscored growing prosecutorial momentum. Source Source Meanwhile, confirmed AI-generated documentation enabled a $2.2 million fraud against Minnesota's Housing Stabilization Services program, demonstrating tangible financial losses from synthetic records. Source Operational voice-cloning threats are maturing on both the attacker and defender sides. New and alleged industrialized vishing and call-spoofing platforms target enterprise users and consumers at scale, while Google rolled out Android protections intended to flag AI deepfake scam calls. Source Source Source Political risks remain active, with an AI-generated attack ad and separate alleged AI-driven forgeries in New York City drawing legal scrutiny. Source Source Regulatory and provenance responses are accelerating in the EU and platforms: the European Commission issued transparency guidance tied to the AI Act, a complementary Code of Practice aims to standardize labeling practices, and TikTok advanced scaled Content Credentials deployment. Source Source Source

incidents.title: AI-enabled impersonation of senior U.S. officials targets sensitive contacts
incidents.summary: Reports describe confirmed AI-enabled impersonation attempts aimed at senior officials and their networks, using synthetic voice and messaging to deceive targets.

incidents.title: U.S. disrupts suspected China-backed network using AI-generated personas

incidents.title: Cross-border takedown of deepfake sexual-abuse sites and assets
